selected_authority: Supported source roots contain only reachable shipped code; dormant/native peers stay hash-preserved in governed labs.
retained_value: Source purity and product reachability are explicit rather than inferred from folder location.
negative_invariant: Live source roots must not regain unreachable/foreign implementation islands.

selected_authority: One Android VPN lifecycle: VpnEngineService -> generated mobilebind AAR -> VPNEngine/CoreController -> system.StartTun2Socks.
retained_value: Transferred TUN ownership and real userspace forwarding survive compatibility entry points.
negative_invariant: No second VpnService, handwritten JNI, fake TUN drain, or unowned transferred FD may become live authority.

selected_authority: One versioned local session descriptor is shared by daemon, desktop, and CLI while both historical descriptor shapes remain accepted for migration.
retained_value: A discovered local daemon is authoritative and legacy descriptors migrate without parallel control state.
negative_invariant: Invalid/unreachable/rejecting discovered sessions must not silently start a second in-process manager.

selected_authority: React source and production embed bytes have one owner under packages/control-ui; daemon browser mode and Wails desktop consume the same Dist seam.
retained_value: One authored UI and one generated bundle serve both hosts.
negative_invariant: apps/desktop/frontend and apps/daemon/internal/webui must not return as independent live UI authorities.

selected_authority: Actual Gin registrations are route authority; the historical 60-row registry is reference evidence and live /api/routes introspects the serving router.
retained_value: Published route inventory cannot claim endpoints that are not registered.
negative_invariant: Static reference rows must never become an independent executable route authority.

selected_authority: Historical shared public-error synthesis was fully retired after its daemon/scanner adapters disappeared and zero production consumers remained.
retained_value: No test-only schema module remains in active source and no live route falsely claims a repository-wide error envelope.
negative_invariant: A shared error contract may return only when at least two live adapters consume one real interface; endpoint-specific error shapes must remain truthful.

selected_authority: One link-time buildinfo contract feeds daemon, watchdog, desktop, CLI, and HTTP version/status surfaces with deterministic commit-derived metadata.
retained_value: Equivalent source builds report one version/commit/build-date identity.
negative_invariant: Build wrappers and executables must not link or hardcode competing version variables.

selected_authority: Rust owns implementations and Cargo owns native link requirements; Go owns one checked private lumicore_abi.h declaration surface, including packed scan layouts.
retained_value: Every Go-used C export/layout is checked against live Rust and host link flags come from Cargo.
negative_invariant: No generated root header, cbindgen build step, hardcoded native library path, stale export, or mismatched packed layout may return.

selected_authority: GitHub Actions is the release authority for host products plus Android AAR and linked APK; the old GoReleaser configuration is reference-only evidence.
retained_value: CI/release build the product-specific dependency graph and publish the linked Android app as a first-class artifact.
negative_invariant: A root GoReleaser authority or AAR-only Android release must not return.

selected_authority: The supported desktop root is one Wails package; unlinked platform/prototype sidecars are preserved byte-for-byte under governed desktop labs.
retained_value: Platform experiments remain reconstructible without masquerading as shipped desktop runtime.
negative_invariant: Unimported platform sidecars must not return beneath apps/desktop.
